preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner.

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the `setMaxTxPercent` function with the `maxTxPercent` parameter set to 0. This will update the `_maxTxAmount` state variable to 0. Consequently, any subsequent transfer between non-owner accounts will fail due to the check `require(amount <= _maxTxAmount)` in the `_transfer` function, effectively halting all trading for regular users.
